admissions.reason: Mobitz Type II Second-Degree Atrioventricular (AV) Block is a specific type of AV block with distinct diagnostic criteria.
R4 is a less specific version of R5, which is Mobitz Type II Second-Degree Atrioventricular (AV) Block. R5 is more precise and supported by the evidence.
R1 is a less specific version of R2, which is Right Bundle Branch Block. R2 is more precise and supported by the evidence.
R3 is a less specific version of R5, which is Mobitz Type II Second-Degree Atrioventricular (AV) Block. R5 is more precise and supported by the evidence.
Right Bundle Branch Block is a distinct finding on ECG, separate from AV block.
Sick Sinus Syndrome is a distinct diagnosis related to sinus node dysfunction, separate from AV block or bundle branch block.
